title: Two-dimensional metal–organic TMTAP monolayers as a promising class of monoatomic electrocatalysts for oxygen reduction, oxygen evolution, and hydrogen evolution reactions
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,30507-30519
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA03135H, Paper

A new class of 2D single-atom metal–organic catalysts formed by embedding 30 transition metals into TAP monolayers are designed as highly efficient electrocatalysts for ORR, OER and HER.
